name: Jayle
source:
A gentlemanly man that works as a casino host at Lurunia.
He's never knows what to do with Bart the compulsive slacker.
He's serious and acts as everybodies restraint.
Because of his work ethic he is trusted by Cecil and Gil.
Because his job is to entertain guests he is quite thoughtful but he's a bit of an idiot when it comes to love.
When he hears about the protagonist's situation he immediately thinks about how he can help her.
